title: One Loss Resolves Signed Rank-One Gradient Fibers: computational artifacts
description: Exact reconstruction software, synthetic public inputs and complete computational outcomes accompanying manuscript jsc-final-2026.10.29.16. Preserves the complete v1.1.0 scientific snapshot and adds standalone exact theta-specialization and two-six-cycle checks, plus a four-route same-input ablation: 16 inputs, 4 methods, 3 repetitions, 192 timed runs. All 180 completed runs and 12 censored 30-second timeouts are retained. The release includes frozen source snapshots, reference lists, output arrays, operation counts, memory measurements and propagation traces. Replays check saved results without remeasuring timings; Linux/WSL timing-repetition instructions are included. Software and synthetic data only; the journal manuscript and private reviews are not distributed.
